name: phase4_qwen25vl_32b_long_prompt_reasoning_1img_1024
prompt: You are evaluating this image for a visual reasoning benchmark. Follow these steps carefully: (1) describe the overall scene, (2) list every visually salient object or region, (3) describe spatial relationships among the objects, (4) identify details that may be easy to miss, (5) reason about what activities or functions the scene may support using only visible evidence, (6) explain uncertainty and avoid unsupported assumptions, and (7) produce a final structured answer with sections for scene summary, objects, spatial layout, evidence, uncertainty, and conclusion.
